title: Pathogenicity of B and CD4 T Cell Subsets in Multiple Sclerosis
official: Pathogenicity of B and CD4 T Cell Subsets in Multiple Sclerosis
summary: The study aims at identifying the type of B and CD4 T cell subsets with pathogenic properties in the different clinical forms of multiple sclerosis. This research might open new therapeutic approaches for the treatment of multiple sclerosis particularly progressive MS.

sites.f: CHU de Bordeaux - service de neurologie
